name: How do agents determine the listing price for a luxury property?

mainEntity.name: How do agents determine the listing price for a luxury property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining the listing price for a luxury property involves a comprehensive market analysis that considers recent comparable sales, unique property features, and prevailing market conditions in specific neighborhoods like Coral Gables or Pinecrest. It also factors in amenities, upgrades, and the overall desirability of the location. Unlike standard homes, luxury pricing often accounts for bespoke elements and lifestyle appeal. Kelby Contreras utilizes detailed market data and local expertise to set a competitive yet aspirational price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury property pricing considers comparable sales, unique features, amenities, and market conditions in specific neighborhoods to set a competitive price.
